unlisted_practices: Involve interdisciplinary experts in an oversight review assessing bias, transparency, and ethical implications before deploying AI in healthcare.
Foster ongoing collaboration among AI developers, clinicians, ethicists, patients, and advocacy groups on AI ethics.
Conduct long-term studies of AI's effects on patient outcomes, efficiency, cost-effectiveness, patient satisfaction, and workflow.
Deploy AI alongside a clinician and treat AI outputs as supportive tools rather than definitive instructions.
Design AI systems to communicate with empathy that respects patients' emotional and psychological needs.
Provide government subsidization, need-prioritizing regulation, or open-source initiatives to expand access to AI for underfunded hospitals.
Report effect sizes and confidence intervals, use appropriate sample sizes, and avoid data shopping in AI evaluation.
Use datasheets or checklists to ensure datasets are representative and balanced.
Incorporate social determinants of health into data collection and algorithm development.
Include avenues for patient feedback and criticism during AI development.
